title: ARG Telemetry Evaluation Block
description: Vector scores, guardrail distances, drift signals, and automated policy decisions from the Orchestration Layer

vector_drift_score.description: Distance of model output from the ground-truth knowledge boundary (0.0 = on boundary, 1.0 = maximum drift)

guardrail_distance.description: Proximity to the nearest policy guardrail threshold

drift_threshold_breached.description: Whether the drift threshold was exceeded at this turn

circuit_breaker_fired.description: Whether a circuit breaker was triggered at this turn

policy_decision.description: Automated policy decision by the Enforcement Layer

policy_rules_evaluated.description: List of policy rule IDs evaluated against this payload

reality_testing_score.description: For educational AI: score indicating whether model is maintaining factual grounding
